    <p>{`The Reframe API automatically adjusts video content to fit different aspect ratios while maintaining visual focus on important elements.
Reframe videos for various social media platforms and add dynamic overlays like GIFs and images with precise timing and positioning controls.`}</p>
    <p>{`This guide provides cURL commands for basic reframing and advanced overlay workflows. For even more technical details and tips, see the `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "../../getting_started/usage/index.md#reframe-api-usage"

    <h2 {...{

    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`You'll need a valid access token and client ID. See the `}<a parentName="li" {...{
          "href": "../../getting_started/index.md"
        }}>{`Authentication Guide`}</a>{` for details.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Upload your media files (audio or video) to `}<a parentName="li" {...{
          "href": "../../getting_started/storage_solutions/index.md"

    </ul>
    <h2 {...{
      "id": "use-reframing-and-scene-edit-detection"
    }}>{`Use reframing and scene edit detection`}</h2>
    <p>{`Use the cURL command example below to reframe your video.
For best results, input video with a 16:9 aspect ratio format.`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-shell"
      }}>{`curl --location 'https://audio-video-api.adobe.io/v2/reframe' \\
--header 'Authorization: \${ACCESS_TOKEN}' \\
--header 'x-api-key: \${CLIENT_ID}' \\
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
--data '{
  "video": {
    "source": {
      "url": "<pre_signed_URL>"
    }
  },
  "analysis": {
    "sceneEditDetection": true
  },
  "output": {
    "renditions": [
      {
        "aspectRatio": {
          "x": 1,
          "y": 1
        }
      },{
        "resolution": {
          "width": 1080,
          "height": 560
        },
        "mediaDestination": {
          "url": "<pre-signed_URL_for_output_video>"
        }
      },
      {
        "aspectRatio": {
          "x": 4,
          "y": 5
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}'
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`In the command, be sure to:`}</p>

      <li parentName="ul">{`Update `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`x-api-key`}</inlineCode>{` with your assigned API key/Client ID.`}</li>
    </ul>

    <h3 {...{
      "id": "activate-semantic-subject-lock"
    }}>{`Activate Semantic Subject Lock`}</h3>
    <InlineAlert variant="info" slots="header, text" mdxType="InlineAlert" />
    <p>{`NOTE`}</p>
    <p>{`This feature relies on focal point and is only available with the Reframe API v2.`}</p>
    <p>{`The Reframe API has `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "../../getting_started/semantic-search/"
      }}><strong parentName="a">{`Semantic Subject Lock`}</strong></a>{`, which allows you to declare a `}<strong parentName="p">{`focal subject`}</strong>{` to guide reframing around a named object or subject using `}<strong parentName="p">{`plain-language keywords`}</strong>{`. These keywords persist across scene boundaries, ensuring the same subject stays locked even through cuts.`}</p>
    <p>{`Omit focal points if:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`You need `}<strong parentName="li">{`fast, hands-off automation`}</strong>{` for well-shot footage (single clear subject, "reframe-aware" composition) and do not require semantic control.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Your content is `}<strong parentName="li">{`center-cut safe`}</strong>{`.`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h4 {...{
      "id": "declare-a-focal-point-subject"

    <p>{`Provide keywords in the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`focalPoints`}</inlineCode>{` array to enable `}<strong parentName="p">{`Semantic Subject Lock`}</strong>{` on an object or product:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

    <p>{`If no focal points are provided, the API defaults to motion-based reframing.`}</p>

    <ul>

      <li parentName="ul">{`With v2, pass exact frame sizes when needed. The Reframe API v2 accepts pixel dimensions (for example, 1080×1920) in addition to aspect ratios, which is useful where platform sizes differ.`}</li>

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{

            "resolution": {

    <ul>

    <h2 {...{

    <p>{`Overlays enable you to add assets as dynamic layers (for example: GIFs, animated PNGs, PNG) on top of a video, customized for positioning, size, timing, and behavior.`}</p>
    <p>{`Use the cURL command example below to extend the Reframe API payload by defining `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`overlays`}</inlineCode>{`. The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`overlays`}</inlineCode>{` array determines how one or more overlay assets are applied.`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-shell"

  },

  }
}'
`}</code></pre>
